title: Playing without a test of similarity

captions.energy: Seeking approval of a shared wish

meaning: Spontaneous play can delight you both when each person is free to enjoy it in their own way.
text: Shared pleasure sometimes begins with a small, ridiculous idea. The Fool in the physical position of Svadhisthana suggests trying without preparation: drawing, inventing or turning away from a familiar route. The Lovers in energy show a difficulty of motive here, wanting immediate confirmation that the other person likes it just as much. The Sun in emotions opens a clear joy in company, laughter and showing yourselves without a heavy role to maintain. Repeatedly checking for a perfect match can interrupt that natural ease.

Suppose you decide to draw each other in five minutes. One person concentrates on details while the other laughs at the face taking shape. Different reactions can prompt an unnecessary question: “Are you even enjoying this?” **Play remains shared when you enjoy it in different ways.** Open pleasure can hold concentration and laughter together. You need not look alike from the outside to share a good moment and later admire a funny result that makes no serious claims.

The vulnerable point is adjusting a spontaneous idea to produce an expected response. You try to please, lose your own interest and wait for clearer approval. A light experiment becomes a quiet examination of reciprocity. The sunny feeling has more space between you when pleasure can speak in each person's own voice, without an obligatory matching reaction.
